definitions.short: some sort of whitish tree, perhaps the storax
definitions.full: H3839. libneh לִבְנֶה noun [masculine] poplar (apparently = Arabic ; Ethiopic styrax officinalis ; but ᵐ5 λεύκη , compare ᵑ6 and Löw No.107 ); — Gen 30:37 ל ׳מַקַּל וְעַרְמוֺן וְלוּז לַח as marking places of idolatrous incense-burning וְּאֵלָה וְלִבְנֶה אַלּוֺן תַּחַת Hosea 4:13 . **named from exuding milky (white) gum De Ges and others.
